in_sanskrit.name: बाकुला
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Bakula is derived from the Bakula tree, which is also known as the Indian Laburnum tree. It is a beautiful tree with pink or white flowers and is considered sacred in Hinduism. The name is believed to bring prosperity, good luck, and happiness.
